script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Gedaliah's appointment and departure are facts from outside this passage and need references.
Ishmael's actions are outside this passage and need a reference. He also needs a brief introduction.
Staying in the land does not necessarily mean staying in the open. The text does not rule out hiding.
The explanation attributes a reason for the LORD's repetition that the text does not give.
The text does not establish that nobody is jealous of anyone.
Moab's location as a neighboring land is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Edom's location as a neighboring land is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
The shadow joke makes light of the sword and famine the LORD warns will overtake the remnant.
The passage does not establish that the people were never headed to Babylon.
The explanation says the people are going to Egypt as a settled fact. This passage says they desire to go, not that they have gone.
The Nile's location in Egypt is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
The text does not give Jeremiah's reason for speaking plainly. A guessed reason is still an added motive.
